item.title: OpenAI Creates a New Framework to Disclose Bad AI Behavior
item.description: The company also disclosed previously unreported incidents in which its AI models behaved in misaligned ways, including uploading files to the internet without being asked.

item.title: Washington Won’t Be Regulating AI Anytime Soon
item.description: Even with mounting concerns about AI models going rogue, legislation appears unlikely, and the White House is outright opposed to oversight.

item.title: I Trained a Fly’s Brain to Generate WIRED Story Ideas
item.description: I used an open-source map of a fruit fly’s brain to vibe code a website called PitchFly. Its headline suggestions were delightfully bananas.

item.title: China Isn’t Buying Silicon Valley’s Call for an AI Slowdown
item.description: The US and China agree that advanced AI poses serious risks. But Beijing is deeply skeptical of a deal that prioritizes keeping US companies ahead.

item.title: AI ‘Actor’ Tilly Norwood Told Me That ‘All Lives Matter’
item.description: The virtual character, which is promoting its upcoming movie Misaligned, tries to evade politics by repetitively commenting on the clothes you’re wearing.

item.title: New York Seizes a Dozen Celebrity Deepfake Websites
item.description: In the biggest-ever legal action against harmful deepfake websites, the Manhattan District Attorney’s Office has seized 12 sites that collectively targeted around 1,200 victims.

item.title: AI Leaders Are Calling for a Slowdown. Trump’s Team Says It’s on Them
item.description: Sam Altman and Elon Musk backed Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei’s weekend plea for regulation. The White House seems unlikely to oblige.

item.title: Sexually Explicit Deepfake Sites Target 100-Plus Politicians in Europe
item.description: An analysis of 160 deepfake websites reveals politicians in 22 countries appear on them. Nearly all of them are women.

item.title: ‘I Like My Big Rat Wife’: Meet the People Using Chatbots to Write Custom Fiction
item.description: While the publishing industry frets over how authors are using AI, many readers are taking things into their own hands.

item.title: AI Agents Are Thirsty for Power
item.description: Silicon Valley is shifting away from chatbot queries toward a future filled with resource-intensive agentic AI—and it's driving the data center buildout.
